create_conv2d_layer: create a Conv2dLayer drop-in replacement for nn.Conv2d with unfold+linear optimization for patch embeddings
create_conv3d_layer: create a Conv3dLayer drop-in replacement for nn.Conv3d with automatic linear optimization to avoid CuDNN bugs
check_enable_linear: check if a convolution configuration can be replaced with unfold + F.linear for faster CUDA execution
validate_conv_args: validate convolution arguments including channel divisibility, padding mode, and stride compatibility
compute_same_padding: compute reversed padding tuple for padding='same' to mirror PyTorch nn.Conv2d/nn.Conv3d behavior
